test_vectorize_objective_costs: test that Vectorize correctly wraps cost functions and computes weighted error for Difference and AutoDiffCostFunction
test_vectorize_schema_grouping: test that Vectorize groups cost functions into schemas based on shared variables, weight types, and dimensions
test_vectorize_autodiff_schemas: test that AutoDiffCostFunction instances are grouped into separate schemas by their error function identity
test_vectorized_retract_optim_vars: test that vectorized retract produces identical results to the base retract method for LieGroup variables
test_masked_jacobians_solver: test that TheseusLayer with vectorize=True produces the same solution as vectorize=False using masked batched jacobians
